sections.title: Creating a Path
sections.content: In a web application, a Route acts as a street sign, directing incoming HTTP requests to the correct destination. The Controller serves as the brain, containing the business logic to process the request and return a response.

examples.explanation: Creates a User route and controller

sections.title: The Code in Action
sections.content: The route file maps simple web requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) to specific functions in the controller.
